notes: family: asymmetric hidden-movement duel. No points. Per official FAQ (Wonderbow): a Shark attack succeeds when the Shark's chosen confrontation card matches the Octopus's (with one pair left, Shark wins automatically); the Shark loses immediately if the Hunger Track fills (e.g. no red die left and only one free slot). Octopus also wins by eating all four seafoods. Not verified against the rulebook itself (PDF not obtainable; Scribd copies blocked): exact Hunger Track size (reviews say 7 or 8 dice) and number of confrontation card pairs (reviews say three pairs, removed after each failed attack). One review states the attack succeeds if cards differ; the official FAQ wording says match, which is used here.
winCondition: Shark: successfully attack the Octopus. Octopus: survive until the Shark is exhausted, or eat all four seafoods.
